character.title: Saiyan Legend Path
character.subtitle: Server-unique Super Saiyan 5–10 chain
character.detail: Unlocks beyond Super Saiyan 4. Requires high Super skill level and prior form mastery. Tuned for competitive DMZ servers.

character.title: Battle Power Focus
character.subtitle: STR / PWR scaling emphasis
character.detail: Legend forms push STR and PWR hardest, with rising energy drain. Master lower stages to unlock free / instant transform thresholds.

character.title: Release Display
character.subtitle: XenoPixels HUD
character.detail: Your custom HUD shows DMZ ki release % next to your name, HP/KI values, and transform charge around the portrait.

transforms.title: Super Saiyan 5
transforms.subtitle: Pale Silver Legend · 120,000 TP
transforms.detail: Fan-legend stage past SSJ4. Silver-white hair, soft violet aura. Req: supersaiyan.supersaiyan4 · Superforms skill Lv.9 · TP 120000 · x4.5 STR/PWR

transforms.subtitle: Crimson Eclipse · 145,000 TP

transforms.subtitle: Void Violet · 175,000 TP
transforms.detail: Purple void-legend stage. Req: ssj6 · Superforms skill Lv.11 · TP 175000 · x6.0 STR/PWR

transforms.subtitle: Crystal White · 210,000 TP

transforms.subtitle: Limit Break Void · 300,000 TP

transforms.title: Super Saiyan Rose
transforms.subtitle: XenoPixels God Forms · 180,000 TP
transforms.detail: DBS Super Saiyan Rosé variant. Pink hair/aura, divine ki feel. Buy skill from Beerus or Whis only · Lv.1 · TP 180000 · x5.5 STR/PWR

transforms.title: Super Saiyan Rose Evolution
transforms.subtitle: XenoPixels God Forms · 240,000 TP
transforms.detail: Rosé Evolution — denser pink aura, higher drain. Req: ssrose · Beerus/Whis skill Lv.2 · TP 240000 · x7.0 STR/PWR

skills.title: XenoPixels God Forms
skills.subtitle: Beerus & Whis only
skills.detail: Super Saiyan Rose and Rose Evolution can only be purchased from Master Beerus or Master Whis (FORMS tab).

skills.title: Legend Form Chain
skills.subtitle: Hold G to transform
skills.detail: DMZ action charge fills the red portrait border. Climb SSJ5→10 only after unlocking Super skill levels and meeting form requisites.

skills.title: Mastery Sharing
skills.subtitle: Neighbor form mastery bleed
skills.detail: Each legend form shares a portion of mastery with adjacent stages so the climb stays usable in long fights.

skills.title: Stack Compatible
skills.subtitle: Works with Kaioken / Ultimate
skills.detail: formStackable is enabled. Pair carefully — stack drain multipliers still apply on top of legend drains.

skills.title: Reload Content
skills.subtitle: /dmzreload config
skills.detail: Forms ship from the mod jar into config/dragonminez/races/saiyan/forms/ on first boot. Edit JSON then /dmzreload config.
